title: annex/v1
description: The front matter of nodes/<id>/annex/<hash>.md (D-31): an informal argument attached to a node as input, never as a claim. The file is markdown whose head is a YAML block delimited by --- lines carrying these fields; the rest is prose, served as demarcated untrusted data (D-28) and read by nothing in the network for truth. The file name is the SHA-256 of the whole file, so the citation a skeleton makes (D-31) is mechanical and an edit is a new annex. licence is required because D-23's amendment accepts annex prose only when its author licenses it at submission. An annex earns nothing on submission and nothing later (D-31), so there is no credit field.

contributor.description: The submitting identity's pseudonym; set by the service, never by the caller

licence.description: SPDX identifier the author licenses this prose under (D-23 amendment)

model_and_tooling.description: What drafted the prose, as declared (D-23); null when a human wrote it
